name: repo-owner
body: The apg operator — a human or the codebase-navigator agent — who runs `apg project start|merge` from the main checkout and owns the repo's lifecycle hygiene. Interest: a merged or abandoned project leaves no residue — no leftover worktrees under `apg/.worktrees/`, no orphan branches — and nothing unsafe is ever deleted (the default branch and the main checkout are untouchable).
